company.name: Fish.qa
company.shortDescription: Fish.qa is an online seafood marketplace
company.description:
Fish.qa is an online seafood market place based in Qatar. Fish.qa is the first initiative of its kind in Qatar in both its aim and scope. We are eager to meet the diverse demands of customers, and they will be able to choose from 60+ varieties of fish available in Qatar, all which will be listed in our site! Fish can be ordered online from our website, or via telephone, and your ordered product will be delivered to your location in the agreed time slot. Local fish stalls from all over Qatar can create unique seller pages in our website and list their fish sales in it. They can also list their offers, promotions, etc. Since there are several fish stalls in Qatar with different product ranges and availability factor, our service will be made available all over Qatar.

Product ranges from fresh and frozen products to marinated and grilled items.
